title: Anytime Fitness vs Contours
meta_desc: Compare Anytime Fitness and Contours Women's Gym NZ prices, contracts, facilities, and value to choose the best gym for your needs.
intro: Anytime Fitness and Contours Women's Gym NZ are two popular gym options in New Zealand, catering to different needs and preferences. Anytime Fitness is a mid-range gym with 24/7 access, while Contours Women's Gym NZ is a community-focused women's gym with a supportive environment. In this comparison, we'll help you decide which gym is best for you.

sections.heading: Overview of Both Gyms
sections.body: Anytime Fitness is a mid-range gym with a wide range of facilities and services, including personal training, an app, and guest passes. It's ideal for frequent travellers and shift workers due to its 24/7 access and global network of over 600 clubs. Contours Women's Gym NZ, on the other hand, is a community-focused women's gym with a supportive environment, group fitness classes, and no lock-in contracts. It's perfect for women who want a non-intimidating space to work out and achieve their fitness goals.

sections.heading: Price and Contract Comparison
sections.body: Anytime Fitness prices range from $16.95 to $22.95 per week, with a $49 joining fee that may be waived at some locations. Most locations require a 12-month contract. Contours Women's Gym NZ prices range from $9.99 to $14.99 per week, with no joining fee on most plans and no lock-in contracts. Consider your budget and commitment level when choosing between these two gyms.
list: Contours Women's Gym NZ: $9.99 - $14.99/week, no lock-in contract

sections.heading: Facilities and Services Comparison
sections.body: Both gyms offer unique facilities and services. Anytime Fitness has 24/7 access, personal training, and a global network of clubs. Contours Women's Gym NZ offers group fitness classes, a supportive community, and circuit-guided sessions. Consider what features are most important to you when deciding between these two gyms.

sections.heading: Verdict and Recommendation
sections.body: Based on the comparison, we recommend Anytime Fitness for frequent travellers, shift workers, and those who want 24/7 access and a global network of clubs. Contours Women's Gym NZ is ideal for women who want a supportive, non-intimidating gym environment with group fitness classes and no lock-in contracts. Don't forget to check if you're eligible for Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, which offers 40-70% off for eligible members. Consider your individual needs and preferences when choosing the best gym for you.
